subject: AuroraGrid x Redwood co-sell demo — availability, agenda and runbook
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@auroragrid.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AuroraGrid x Redwood co-sell demo — availability, agenda and runbook

Hi Lisa —

Great speaking yesterday. AuroraGrid's interest in a joint marketplace + SI demo for AuroraGrid customers sounds like a perfect fit. We'd like to lock a 60-minute technical + commercial runthrough where we: 1) show a short walkthrough of Redwood's hosted inference and private deployment modes for regulated customers, 2) demo the SI integration pattern (auth, VPC peering, data flow), and 3) discuss next steps for marketplace listing and co-sell enablement.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Mar 1, 13:00–14:00
- Wed Mar 2, 09:00–10:00
- Thu Mar 3, 17:00–18:00 (for APAC overlap)

Can you confirm which of those works for your engineering lead and your AWS contact? If none, send a couple of options and we'll adapt.

I attached a short co-sell demo proposal and suggested agenda (co-sell-demo-proposal.pdf).

If this looks good I’ll loop in our SE and partner manager to confirm hosts and runbook. Also: do you want us to include a short pre-recorded slide deck for customers (demo-slide-deck.pptx) so your CS team can reuse it?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: co-sell-demo-proposal.pdf

Thanks, Vanessa — that looks promising. Our engineering lead (Ben) is available Tue Mar 1 13:00–14:00 and Thu Mar 3 17:00–18:00. AWS PM (cc'd) is confirming whether they can join Mar 1; if not, they can do the Thu window.

A couple of asks from our side before we lock:
- Can Redwood provide a short runbook for the demo (checklist + host responsibilities)?
- We'll need a short slide deck we can share with prospective customers after the demo.
- Any compliance blurbs (data residency/KMS) that we should include in the marketplace listing?

If Mar 1 works with AWS, let's lock it — otherwise Thu is our fallback.

—Lisa
Lisa Chen
Head of Partnerships | AuroraGrid
lisa@auroragrid.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Feb 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AuroraGrid x Redwood co-sell demo — availability, agenda and runbook

Vanessa / Soojin —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick operational notes from the SE side:
- We can cover the infra flow and private deploy pattern in ~25 minutes; recommend a 10-minute customer Q&A and 10-minute commercial/marketplace discussion. Keeps it tight for cross-org attendees.
- Runbook: I started a draft (auroragrid-runbook-draft.md) with host checklist, slide order, and failure fallback (fallback to hosted demo if private staging fails). I attached the draft to this thread.
- Hosts: I can host the technical portion; Vanessa should lead the commercial close with AuroraGrid. Soojin — can you confirm partner-facing slides and if we need an AM on the invite?

Also, on the APAC overlap: rather than a single long session, we should keep this 60m and offer a shorter follow-up tailored for AuroraGrid APAC customers (20–30m). That reduces scheduling friction.

If Mar 1 is the pick we should schedule a 30-minute rehearsal Tue Feb 23 (PST) — SE + partner + AuroraGrid engineer.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: auroragrid-runbook-draft.md
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@auroragrid.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, AWS PM <aws_pm@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Feb 2028 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AuroraGrid x Redwood co-sell demo — availability, agenda and runbook

Thanks Lisa — locking Tue Mar 1, 13:00–14:00 PST. AWS PM indicated they expect to join but flagged that if their senior SA can't make it they will send a backup.

Final plan (confirmed):
- When: Tue Mar 1, 2028 | 13:00–14:00 PST
- Host: Karthik (technical), Vanessa (commercial & marketplace next steps)
- Attendees: AuroraGrid engineering + Head of Partnerships (Lisa), Redwood SE (Karthik), Redwood Partner Lead (Soojin), AWS PM (TBD)
- Agenda: 5m intro, 25m technical walkthrough, 10m customer scenario, 10m marketplace listing & commercial, 10m Q&A / next steps
- Rehearsal: Tue Feb 23, 09:00–09:30 PST (SE + AuroraGrid engineer + partner lead) — please confirm availability.

Runbook + slide deck: link sent here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-auroragrid-runbook (contains auroragrid-runbook-draft.md and demo-slide-deck.pptx). I've attached the co-sell proposal again for commercial talking points.

Action items:
- Lisa: confirm Ben and the AuroraGrid engineer for rehearsal (reply with names)
- Karthik: finalize runbook checklist and operator fallback section by Feb 17
- Soojin: confirm partner-facing slides and AM presence by Feb 20

If anything changes (AWS availability or attendee list) we'll pivot; otherwise I'll send the calendar invite with dial-in + recording settings after Lisa confirms attendees.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
